credit: Researched and cited by soda.strudel (RES-M-001). Each piece belongs to its author; follow the link to hear or read it.

songs.title: 2 Minute Deep Acid in Strudel (from scratch)
songs.about: Video by Switch Angel. Teaches a quick 303-style line: resonance and envelope.
songs.teaches: a quick 303-style line: resonance and envelope
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Flatrave
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches filter envelope (lpenv) and cutoff sweeps.

songs.title: Gorillaz – Feel Good Inc (cover)
songs.about: Feel Good Inc at a slow cpm with vinyl crackle, DR-550 drums, jazz and overdriven guitars, scale and voicing, orbit separation.

songs.title: Coding AMBIENT Music in Strudel (from scratch)
songs.about: Video by typedbeats. Teaches slow pads, reverb, sparse randomness.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Radiohead – Pyramid Song
songs.about: Pyramid Song's famously uneven, swung rhythm – a study in non-square timing.

songs.title: Radiohead - Everything in its right place
songs.about: Everything In Its Right Place in 25 lines: an FM piano, a TR-909 kick and a punchcard visual – a compact example of FM synthesis.

songs.title: Amen break SPEEDRUN
songs.about: Video by Switch Angel. Teaches fast break slicing.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Dmitri Shostakovich – Waltz #2
songs.about: Waltz No. 2 from the Suite for Variety Orchestra; tempo shaped with cps functions (waltzno2.js).

songs.title: Joseph Haydn - Keyboard sonata #49 (Eb Maj) (3rd movement) (cover)
songs.about: Haydn's Sonata No. 49, 3rd movement, on piano – transcribed by Biscuit and tzwaan with scale degrees and add. The composition is public domain; the transcription script has no license.

songs.title: Bass fuge
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches counterpoint by off/add transposition, sometimes.

songs.title: Coding DRUM and BASS
songs.about: Video by Switch Angel. Teaches building DnB drums and bass from scratch, narrated.
songs.teaches: building DnB drums and bass from scratch, narrated
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Belldub
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches delay/room dub space, degradeBy, superimpose.

songs.title: Strudel Live Coding #39: Dark Dub Techno
songs.about: Video by Wave Coder. Teaches chord stabs through delay feedback.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Vardis Quo
songs.about: Appears to be an original piece: flute and jazz guitar over DR-550 drums and a supersaw, voicings and a pianoroll.

songs.title: Bug From Heaven (cover)
songs.about: Cover from eefano's songs collection (bugfromheaven.js); Bakery share.

songs.title: Grimes – Music 4 Machines (cover)
songs.about: Cover of the Grimes track, shared from the strudel.cc REPL and announced on r/Grimes; a pop song structure rebuilt as patterns.

songs.title: Corona – The Rhythm of the Night
songs.about: Nineties eurodance: four-on-the-floor, piano stabs and a big hook.

songs.title: dough dream #1 – strudel jam 12/03/23
songs.about: Video by eddyflux. Teaches improvised long-form development (on the Showcase).
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Dinofunk
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches clip, superimpose, groove with probability.

songs.title: Random bells
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches randomness in scales, range, long slow layers.
songs.teaches: randomness in scales, range, long slow layers

songs.title: Technotronic – Pump Up The Jam (cover)
songs.about: Hip-house classic: drum machine groove and a sparse synth riff.

songs.title: Coding a Lo-fi Hip Hop Beat in Strudel (from scratch)
songs.about: Video by typedbeats. Teaches swing, laid-back drums, dusty keys.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Strudel coding house music
songs.about: Video by dadadada. Teaches four-on-the-floor, off-beat hats and chords.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Charli XCX – 360 (cover / remix)
songs.about: Cover/remix of "360" shared from the REPL and posted on X; a modern pop drum and synth arrangement.

songs.title: Giant Steps
songs.by: John Coltrane (composition); in the stock file without @by
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches fast chord changes with voicing.

songs.title: Chopping jungle breaks in #STRUDEL
songs.about: Video by Iganu music. Teaches chop/slice break edits.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Amensister
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches Amen-style break handling, off layering, filter ranges.
songs.teaches: Amen-style break handling, off layering, filter ranges

songs.title: Lounge sponge
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches chord voicing, Csound instrument use.

songs.title: Only for the DMG 101 ("Only for the Weak" - In Flames) (cover)
songs.about: In Flames' Only for the Weak played like a Game Boy (DMG): pulse waves, supersaw, a lowpass envelope (lpenv), sometimes, noise drums – a 490-line long-form piece with a prebake script.

songs.title: Slaughter of the Toad ("Slaughter of the Soul" - At The Gates) (cover)
songs.about: At the Gates' Slaughter of the Soul with a Battletoads soundfont – very long (1,180 lines), noise-drum patterns written out in mini-notation.

songs.title: Livecoding melodic DNB music in Strudel
songs.about: Video by Switch Angel. Teaches harmony over breakbeats.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Birds of a Feather - Billie Eilish (Remake)
songs.about: A remake of Birds of a Feather; Bakery share with a YouTube walkthrough by saga_3k.

songs.title: DJ_Dave – Array [Lil Data Edit] (Strudel Version)
songs.about: Video by DJ_Dave / Lil Data (uploader). Teaches song-form pop arrangement in code (on the Showcase).
songs.teaches: song-form pop arrangement in code (on the Showcase)
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: New Order - Blue Monday
songs.about: Blue Monday with its iconic kick-drum fill; drum layers on the 909/808 style banks, a sawtooth lead, a GM synth bass and a pianoroll. Uses arrange-like sections at 130 bpm (setcpm(130/4)), scale, hpf, room.
songs.teaches: arrange sections and an iconic drum fill

songs.title: Enjoy The Silence (coda)
songs.about: Script by eefano (song by Depeche Mode). Teaches transcribing a pop arrangement.

songs.title: Stranger Things (Netflix Series)
songs.about: The Stranger Things title theme: arpeggiated analogue-style synth line over a pad.

songs.title: Caverave
songs.about: Stock tune by Felix Roos in the Strudel repo. Teaches struct + mask arrangement, scaleTranspose, pianoroll visual.
songs.teaches: struct + mask arrangement, scaleTranspose, pianoroll visual

songs.title: Happy Birthday
songs.about: The birthday song – a simple melody, good first transcription exercise.

songs.title: Old McDonalds
songs.about: The children's song – simple melody and repetition.

songs.title: Coding Trance Music: in the beginning
songs.about: Video by Switch Angel. Teaches supersaw and build-up structure.
songs.license: unknown – video; code license not stated

songs.title: Boulders - Crash Bandicoot (cover)
songs.about: Boulders from Crash Bandicoot: didgeridoo, kalimba and melodic toms, FM, vowel filter, rib and filterWhen – unusual instrument choices.

songs.title: Toby Fox - Home (cover)
songs.about: Undertale's Home: nylon guitar arpeggios (arp, seg) and a tempo pattern that changes over the piece.

songs.title: Toby Fox - Megalovania (cover)
songs.about: Megalovania transcribed by tzwaan with the MT-32 sound set, FM, pick and multi-parameter mini-notation (s:n:gain). Shows packing many controls into one pattern.

songs.title: Toby Fox – Megalovania (cover)
songs.about: Megalovania with voicings, dict, pick, struct, AkaiLinn drums, a clean electric guitar and a GM bass, with a pianoroll. Shows chord voicing and switching parts with pick.

songs.title: Determination - Toby Fox (cover)
songs.about: Undertale's Determination with square and triangle waves only – chiptune voices, shape distortion, room. 115 bpm. The author says it was made to learn Strudel.

songs.title: Goldenrod City - Pokemon (cover)
songs.about: Goldenrod City minified to 11 lines: saw/square/noise voices, arp, seg, struct – a lesson in compact pattern writing.

songs.title: Kraid's Lair - Metroid (cover)
songs.about: Kraid's Lair in 22 lines: square and triangle waves in 3/4-based cpm (224/3), jux stereo, crush and a scope.

songs.title: Lavender Town - Pokemon (cover)
songs.about: Lavender Town in 18 lines: pulse waves, white-noise percussion through a bandpass, FM and conditional filters.

songs.title: Mt. Moon - Pokemon (cover)
songs.about: Mt. Moon with pulse waves and per-section tempo via setCps; adsr envelopes and conditional transforms (when).

songs.title: Super mario bros. main theme (cover)
songs.about: The Super Mario Bros. theme at 200 bpm: pulse/triangle voices, noise drums (pink/white), crush, struct and a scope visual. A long (350-line) transcription – good for reading how a full song is laid out.

songs.title: Vegetable Valley - Kirby's Adventure
songs.about: Vegetable Valley with saw/square/triangle/noise voices and multi-control mini-notation (dec:lp:hp:gain), rib and filterWhen.

learn.title: Strudel Songs Collection
learn.about: A large collection of Strudel songs and covers by eefano (the source for 9 tracks above). Script license: none stated – link and ask before adapting.

learn.title: Strudel Neovim Controller
learn.about: strudel.nvim – drive strudel.cc from Neovim: write patterns in your editor, play them in the browser. AGPL-3.0.

learn.title: MIDI to Strudel
learn.about: Converts MIDI files into Strudel note notation (Python script or an HTML page). GPL-3.0.

learn.title: midi-strudel
learn.about: Browser MIDI-to-Strudel converter: finds key, tempo, time signature and drum tracks, writes each track as absolute notes or scale degrees. No license stated.

learn.title: Melograph
learn.about: Hum or upload a melody, inspect its pitch contour and notes, edit, then open the generated Strudel code. GPL-3.0.

learn.title: PLAYER
learn.about: A local-first Strudel song builder: live code editor, step sequencer, piano roll, sound browser, timeline/arrangement, effect knobs, .strudel import/export. AGPL-3.0.

learn.title: maria-live-codes
learn.about: MariaAreadne's cover songs for Strudel (Megalovania, Feel Good Inc, Vardis Quo and more) – copy into strudel.cc and play. No license stated.

learn.title: Toaster
learn.about: Listens to a song and writes it out as Strudel code as it plays – kick, hats, bass line, chords – then opens it in strudel.cc. MIT.

learn.title: Learning Music Production with Strudel: Free Course for Total Beginners
learn.about: A free, chaptered course on music production in the browser with Strudel, by terryds (who also keeps awesome-strudel). No license stated.

learn.title: Live Coding For Music With Strudel.cc (Beginners)
learn.about: YouTube beginner tutorial by Groovin in G: first patterns, drums and melody in strudel.cc.

learn.title: Official Strudel Guide
learn.about: The official getting-started workshop on strudel.cc – the canonical first lesson. Strudel docs: AGPL-3.0 project; check the site for content terms.

learn.title: Creative Code Art - WORKSHOP // Coding Music With Strudel // Dan Gorelick and Viola He
learn.about: Recorded workshop by Dan Gorelick and Viola He (Creative Code Art) – coding music with Strudel from the ground up.

learn.title: Intro To Algorave (Strudel Workshop)
learn.about: glfmn's "Intro to Algorave" Strudel workshop – slides/notes introducing algorave culture and live coding.

learn.title: Learn how to make music through live coding // Lucy Cheesman
learn.about: Lucy Cheesman (Heavy Lifting) on making music by live coding, recorded by Site Gallery.

learn.title: Beats, Bytes, and Basslines: An Introduction to Live Coding Music with Strudel CC
learn.about: Mirakl Tech blog article introducing live-coding music with strudel.cc. The site refuses automated requests (403) – open it by hand to confirm.

learn.title: MariaAreadne – Strudel Covers & Tutorials
learn.about: YouTube channel of MariaAreadne: live-coded covers and walkthroughs.

learn.title: strudel samples
learn.about: strudel-samples.alternet.site – search and preview samples from known Strudel sample packs and add your own.
